subject: Request: Exec approval for bundled onboarding + premium SLA exception
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyanka.singh@stccorp.com, carlos.mendes@stccorp.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal: Bundled onboarding + premium support (SCCA)

Hi Priyanka / Carlos,

Thanks for taking the time last week. Attached is the proposal and pricing summary for the 12-month Redwood deployment we discussed. Key highlights:

- Core inference API for 3 production routes (chat, embeddings, rerank)
- Bundled onboarding: 4-week hands-on onboarding + one custom connector (Salesforce) included
- Premium support tier included (24/7 escalation, 1-hr P1 SLA)
- One-time onboarding fee: $45,000 (included in bundle)
- Annual committed spend: $420,000, list discount 18% applied in summary

The customer has asked for two exceptions that will need internal approval:
1) Reduce onboarding timeline to 3 weeks (compressing deliverables)
2) Add 2 additional custom connectors (NetSuite + Looker) beyond the included Salesforce connector

Both items increase scope and margin pressure. Rishi, Neha — can you advise on whether we route this through deal desk for an exec-level discount or accept as a paid add-on? If deal desk requires an approval memo, I included the current numbers in the pricing_summary_20260601.xlsx attachment.

Priyanka/Carlos — if you can confirm which connectors are critical we can firm up the SOW.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOW_v1_20260601.pdf, pricing_summary_20260601.xlsx
From: Priyanka.Singh@stccorp.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: carlos.mendes@stccorp.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal: Bundled onboarding + premium support (SCCA)

Laura,

Thanks — quick clarifying notes from our side:
- We need NetSuite and Looker connectors live by the end of the onboarding (3-week target). NetSuite is highest priority.
- The 1-hr P1 SLA is a requirement for our compliance team; if not standard we will need it in contract.
- Given the compressed schedule and two extra connectors, our procurement lead has asked for a 25% one-time credit on the onboarding fee.

We are excited to move forward but need those exceptions signed off by your leadership. Carlos and I are available Wed/Thu for a short call if that helps.

Regards,
Priyanka Singh
Senior Director, AI Platforms
STC Corporation

---
Attachment: internal_risk_notes.docx (referenced)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: dealdesk@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Exec approval request - STC bundled onboarding exceptions (DL-2026-1147)

Team — forwarding the thread. Executive approval requested for two non-standard items: compressed 3-week onboarding and inclusion of two extra connectors (NetSuite, Looker) at the bundled price with a one-time 25% onboarding credit request.

Summary of impact:
- Gross contract value remains $420k/year, but onboarding margin is negative under requested credit.
- Additional engineering effort estimate: ~160 engineer-hours to build and QA two connectors within compressed timeline; projected incremental cost ~$28k.
- Operational risk: meeting 1-hr P1 SLA requires a staffed on-call rotation during onboarding and first 60 days.

Options for approval:
A) Approve 25% onboarding credit, require Addendum A (limited scope) and 120-day technical support retention clause; assign onboarding SOW to Professional Services with dedicated PM (preferred).
B) Decline credit; offer connectors as billable add-ons at $35k each and keep standard 4-week onboarding.
C) Approve a partial credit (10-15%) with a commitment to upgrade to Dedicated capacity within 6 months (upsell trigger).

Attachments: pricing_summary_20260601.xlsx, Addendum_A_draft.docx, SOC2_excerpt.pdf

Aditya — can you weigh in with approval or recommended edits? This will need an exec OK to proceed to contracting.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exec approval request - STC bundled onboarding exceptions (DL-2026-1147)

Rishi — reviewed. I approve option C with the following conditions:

1) Offer a one-time onboarding credit of 15% (applied to the $45k onboarding line)
2) Include Addendum A to the MSA that scopes NetSuite + Looker connectors as deliverables and a 60-day acceptance window for each connector
3) Capture commitment to evaluate Dedicated capacity upgrade at 6 months; include a break clause if Redwood cannot meet 1-hr P1 SLA for two consecutive P1 incidents in the first 90 days
4) Ensure SOC2 excerpt and runbook are provided to STC within 48 hours of signature

Rationale: this balances margin protection and the commercial motion. If engineering confirms the 160-hour estimate is optimistic, we can re-open the discount.

Rishi — please update Addendum_A_draft.docx with the acceptance metrics and routing, then move to legal for redline. Laura — communicate the approved terms and next steps to the customer and propose a DocuSign path for the addendum.

-Aditya
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyanka.singh@stccorp.com, carlos.mendes@stccorp.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal: Bundled onboarding + premium support (SCCA) - approved terms

Priyanka/Carlos — good news. Leadership approved a conditional exception: a one-time 15% credit on the onboarding fee and inclusion of NetSuite + Looker connectors as scoped deliverables via Addendum A. A few next steps:

- I will upload the Addendum A (signed by us) to DocuSign today. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/abc-1147
- Please review acceptance criteria in the Addendum: 60-day acceptance window per connector, functional tests and handoff checklist.
- Neha (CC) will be your CS lead for onboarding; she will schedule the kick-off next Tues and own the runbook.
- SOC2 runbook excerpt attached for your compliance team.

If that all looks good I will send the DocuSign envelope and we can lock calendar for the compressed 3-week schedule. Thanks for the patience — excited to get started.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Addendum_A_draft.docx, SOC2_excerpt.pdf
